description: Build a pain.001 SEPA XML batch from a payments table, validating IBANs and amounts. When a batch of SEPA credit transfers must be produced from a table. Do not choose this when the file must be signed or submitted to a bank. Example requests: Build a SEPA payment file from these rows. | Generate a pain.001 XML batch. | Turn this payment list into a SEPA file.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

payments.description: The customer's payments.csv, as text. Supported: CSV with a header row. The payments to send. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_sepa_payment_file_builder
title: SEPA payment file builder
